# 12-Week Resistance Training Programme for PCOS & Insulin Sensitivity
**Client: 31F | Recreational Lifter | PCOS (Rotterdam) | HbA1c 5.8 | BMI 28**
**Programme Start: 1 June 2026 | Duration: 12 weeks**

---

## PROGRAMME OVERVIEW & PHILOSOPHY

This programme prioritises **metabolic health and insulin sensitivity** through structured resistance training, with careful attention to energy balance and recovery. The design reflects current evidence that resistance training is superior to aerobic work for PCOS management, particularly for improving insulin action and body composition.

**Key Principles:**
- **Adequate fuelling**: No caloric deficit; focus on body recomposition through training stimulus
- **Moderate training volume**: 3 resistance sessions per week (12–16 sets per muscle group weekly)
- **Minimal cardio**: 1 optional low-intensity session (walking, cycling) for recovery, not energy deficit
- **Cycle awareness**: Adjust intensity/volume slightly in luteal phase if needed, but no dramatic changes
- **Progressive overload**: Linear progression in strength; modest hypertrophy stimulus
- **Recovery emphasis**: Sleep, stress management, and adequate protein intake

---

## PHASE STRUCTURE

| Phase | Weeks | Focus | Primary Stimulus |
|-------|-------|-------|------------------|
| **Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation** | 1–4 | Movement quality, work capacity, baseline strength | Moderate intensity (RPE 6–7), higher reps |
| **Phase 2: Strength & Hypertrophy** | 5–8 | Progressive overload, muscle building, insulin sensitivity | Higher intensity (RPE 7–8), moderate reps |
| **Phase 3: Consolidation & Deload** | 9–12 | Strength maintenance, recovery, metabolic adaptation | Mixed intensity, strategic deload |

---

## PHASE 1: FOUNDATION & ADAPTATION (WEEKS 1–4)

**Objective:** Establish movement patterns, build work capacity, assess baseline strength, and allow the nervous system to adapt to training stimulus without excessive fatigue.

**Training Structure:** 3 sessions per week (Monday/Wednesday/Friday or similar)
- **Session A (Lower Emphasis)**: Squat-based, posterior chain
- **Session B (Upper Emphasis)**: Horizontal push/pull
- **Session C (Upper Emphasis)**: Vertical push/pull + accessory

**Weekly Volume Target:** 12–14 sets per muscle group

---

### WEEK 1

**Session A (Lower) — Monday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Goblet Squat | 3 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 90s | Focus on depth, knee tracking |
| Romanian Deadlift (RDL) | 3 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 90s | Hamstring/glute emphasis |
| Leg Press | 2 × 10 | 2-1-2 | 75s | Accessory; higher reps for work capacity |
| Leg Curl (machine) | 2 × 12 | 2-1-1 | 60s | Posterior chain isolation |
| Calf Raise (standing) | 2 × 15 | 1-1-2 | 45s | Light, high reps |

**Total: 12 sets | Duration: ~45 min**

---

**Session B (Upper) — Wednesday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 3 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | Main lift; establish baseline |
| Bent-Over Barbell Row | 3 × 6 | 2-1-1 | 2 min | Horizontal pull; equal volume to press |
| Dumbbell Incline Press | 2 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 90s | Upper chest, shoulder stability |
| Seal Row (or machine row) | 2 × 10 | 2-1-1 | 75s | Accessory; reduce lower back demand |
| Face Pull | 2 × 12 | 1-1-2 | 60s | Rear delt, shoulder health |

**Total: 12 sets | Duration: ~50 min**

---

**Session C (Upper) — Friday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Overhead Press (barbell) | 3 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | Vertical push; main lift |
| Lat Pulldown (or assisted pull-up) | 3 × 6 | 2-1-1 | 2 min | Vertical pull; equal volume |
| Dumbbell Lateral Raise | 2 × 10 | 2-1-2 | 75s | Shoulder abduction |
| Machine Chest Fly | 2 × 10 | 2-1-2 | 75s | Pec isolation |
| Barbell Curl | 2 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 60s | Arm accessory |

**Total: 12 sets | Duration: ~48 min**

---

### WEEK 2

Repeat Week 1 structure. **Progression:** Add 1–2 reps to each set if form is solid, or maintain reps and focus on movement quality. Record all weights.

---

### WEEK 3

**Session A (Lower) — Monday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Back Squat | 3 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | Progress from goblet; establish baseline |
| RDL | 3 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 90s | Maintain |
| Leg Press | 2 × 10 | 2-1-2 | 75s | +1–2 reps or +2.5–5 kg |
| Leg Curl | 2 × 12 | 2-1-1 | 60s | Maintain |
| Calf Raise | 2 × 15 | 1-1-2 | 45s | Maintain |

**Total: 12 sets**

---

**Session B (Upper) — Wednesday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 3 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | +1–2 reps or +2.5 kg |
| Bent-Over Row | 3 × 6 | 2-1-1 | 2 min | +1–2 reps or +2.5 kg |
| Dumbbell Incline Press | 2 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 90s | +1 rep or +2.5 kg per hand |
| Seal Row | 2 × 10 | 2-1-1 | 75s | +1–2 reps |
| Face Pull | 2 × 12 | 1-1-2 | 60s | +1–2 reps |

**Total: 12 sets**

---

**Session C (Upper) — Friday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Overhead Press | 3 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | +1–2 reps or +1.25 kg |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 × 6 | 2-1-1 | 2 min | +1–2 reps or +2.5 kg |
| Dumbbell Lateral Raise | 2 × 10 | 2-1-2 | 75s | +1 rep or +1 kg per hand |
| Machine Chest Fly | 2 × 10 | 2-1-2 | 75s | +1–2 reps |
| Barbell Curl | 2 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 60s | +1 rep or +1.25 kg |

**Total: 12 sets**

---

### WEEK 4 (Deload Week)

Reduce volume and intensity to allow recovery and assess adaptation.

**Session A (Lower) — Monday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Back Squat | 2 × 5 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | Reduce to 2 sets; maintain weight |
| RDL | 2 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 90s | Reduce volume |
| Leg Press | 2 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 75s | Reduce reps |
| Leg Curl | 1 × 10 | 2-1-1 | 60s | Single set |
| Calf Raise | 1 × 12 | 1-1-2 | 45s | Single set |

**Total: 8 sets | Duration: ~35 min**

---

**Session B (Upper) — Wednesday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 2 × 5 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | Reduce to 2 sets |
| Bent-Over Row | 2 × 5 | 2-1-1 | 2 min | Reduce to 2 sets |
| Dumbbell Incline Press | 1 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 90s | Single set |
| Seal Row | 1 × 8 | 2-1-1 | 75s | Single set |
| Face Pull | 1 × 10 | 1-1-2 | 60s | Single set |

**Total: 7 sets | Duration: ~35 min**

---

**Session C (Upper) — Friday**

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Rest | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Overhead Press | 2 × 5 | 2-1-2 | 2 min | Reduce to 2 sets |
| Lat Pulldown | 2 × 5 | 2-1-1 | 2 min | Reduce to 2 sets |
| Dumbbell Lateral Raise | 1 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 75s | Single set |
| Machine Chest Fly | 1 × 8 | 2-1-2 | 75s | Single set |
| Barbell Curl | 1 × 6 | 2-1-2 | 60s | Single set |

**Total: 7 sets | Duration: ~35 min**

---

**Phase 1 Summary:**
- Established baseline strength across main lifts
- Built movement competency and work capacity
- Introduced progressive overload principles
- Deload week allows nervous system recovery
- Client should feel energised, not fatigued

---

## PHASE 2: STRENGTH & HYPERTROPHY (WEEKS 5–8)

**Objective:** Increase training intensity and volume to drive strength gains and modest muscle hypertrophy, which improves insulin sensitivity and metabolic rate. Maintain adequate fuelling.

**Training Structure:** 3 sessions per week (same schedule)
- **Session A (Lower)**: Squat-based + posterior chain
- **Session B (Upper)**: Horizontal push/pull
- **Session C (Upper)**: Vertical push/pull + accessory

**Weekly Volume Target:** 14–16 sets per muscle group
